predecessors.name: South Africa
predecessors.text: South West Africa, which 'gained independence as Namibia' on 21 March 1990, without Walvis Bay and the Penguin Islands, which 'remained under South African control until 1994'

ledger.x: 1990: Namibia becomes independent from South Africa.
1994: Walvis Bay returns to Namibia on 1 March.

wars.name: Second Congo War
wars.outcome: No territorial result for Namibia: 'In 1998, Namibia Defence Force troops were sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo' as part of a SADC contingent.

wars.name: Caprivi Strip secessionist attempt
wars.outcome: The government 'quashed a secessionist attempt in the northeastern Caprivi Strip' in 1999; the rebels (Caprivi Liberation Army, led by Mishake Muyongo) held no ground the page records, so no contested zone is drawn.

certainty.note: Walvis Bay's boundary is the 1911 settlement ('a confirmed area of 1,124 square kilometres'), the rest are colonial-era treaty and survey lines; the Namibia page says Namibia 'has been involved in various disputes regarding borders'…
